title: Apple Music will soon get visible labels for AI-generated content - 9to5Mac
summary: Earlier this year, Apple announced that Apple Music would soon require AI transparency disclosures for new artwork, tracks, compositions, and music videos added to the platform. We define Al-platform-generated content as anything that is primarily derived from a generative Al service.
